title: Landmark map symbols, anchored to real HSL stops

source.dataset: Authored map symbols. NOT survey data and NOT OpenStreetMap geometry.
source.method: Each landmark is placed as an offset IN METRES from a stop in cities/helsinki.json. The stop coordinate is real source data (HSL GTFS, CC BY 4.0); the offset is authored, and is the only invented number in this file.
source.isNot: These are not building footprints. Nothing here is traced, measured or fetched. A landmark marks a place that exists at roughly the right spot — accurate to about a block — the way a symbol on a paper map does. Do not present it as geometry, do not derive distances from it, and do not credit OpenStreetMap for it.
source.replaceWith: OSM building ways for each of these, fetched on a machine with outbound access, would make the positions real. The schema would not have to change: an `at` pair could replace `anchor`+`offset` per entry.
source.attribution: Landmark positions authored for Toko Move; stop coordinates © Helsingin seudun liikenne (HSL), CC BY 4.0

coordinateSystem: offset metres {n, e} from the named anchor
